title: The Glowworm Cavern
text: A cavern lit by glowworms, their light hanging from the ceiling in threads like stars, so many that it looks like a summer night. The floor is soft moss. The air is warm and smells of rain. After so much dark, it is very hard to leave.

options.label: Rest here a while, under the false stars, and let the dark wait.

outcomes.text: You rest well under the false stars, warm and soft, the air smelling of rain.

options.label: The sharpest gathers worms for light, against the dark ahead.

outcomes.text: Jars of soft light go with you into the dark ahead, which keeps its distance.

options.label: Follow the worms deeper in, to see where the light begins.

outcomes.text: They lead to something that eats them. It is still hungry.
